_comment: Parametric board definition for build_board.py. Board frame: bx right, by up, viewed from the TOP (lid side); KiCad frame x=bx, y=H-by. Origin in the pod frame: x_pod = x_r1 + 2.6 + bx, y_pod = 1.5 + by. The mechanical owner may change outline/zones here and rebuild (tail_length_mm = w - 16.7).

dock_insert_reserve.note: only the dock halls below the board

battery_bay.note: cell 15 x 10 x 3.2; spring contacts are the only bottom parts

spindle_magnet_strip.note: TMAG5273 under the spindle magnet only

antenna_keepout.note: E73 ceramic antenna end, both sides
